Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog: Fix Animations-tab queueing: the queued/highlighted identity is now the mod+option (e.g. "GoonersLife — Animation 34") instead of the ambiguous generic pose slot name, and the whole path (mod, group/option, Play button) highlights together. Fix preset sync: only the anchor and name travel to your partner now — pose, offset, and Penumbra link are captured from whatever they're already playing, not copied from you.
